shortIntro.title: Is Your Phone Fast Enough for Need for Speed No Limits? 🏎️⚡📱
shortIntro.para1: Need for Speed No Limits is pure underground racing — nitro boosts, sharp drifts, close-call corners, and cinematic cop chases. When performance drops, even a hypercar feels painfully slow 😅.
shortIntro.para2: Quick reflexes, smooth drifting, and instant nitro timing rely on solid GPU power, enough RAM, and decent storage speed. Lag doesn’t forgive mistakes — it sends you straight to second place 🚓💨.

faqIntroText: Need for Speed No Limits FAQs — quick answers before the next race 😎:

faqList.question: Is Need for Speed No Limits demanding on hardware?
faqList.answer: Moderately. The game is optimized well, but stronger hardware provides smoother visuals and faster loading.

faqList.question: Does Need for Speed No Limits support 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, on mid-range and flagship devices. Budget phones usually stay close to 30 FPS.

faqList.question: Why does my phone heat up during long sessions?
faqList.answer: High-speed racing, visual effects, and reflections push the GPU hard. Lower graphics and breaks help 😅.
